# Wikinews licence notice

Licence identifier: Creative Commons Attribution 2.5.

Canonical URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/

This notice applies to raw Wikinews text and to direct adaptations of that
text, including source text, sentence text, lemmas, mention forms, offsets,
and values retained in the operational TextGraphs and in publication views
that copy those spans.

It does not apply to:

- MEANTIME packaging metadata such as publicId and corpus filenames, which is attributed under CC BY 4.0 in `../MEANTIME/`. The annotated MEANTIME files are not included in the release
- TextGraphX graph structure, which is an authored transformation and still
  carries this notice wherever source text is retained
- study code, the ontology, SHACL profiles, or public label tables

The local raw NAF files do not contain a licence header. Nothing in those
headers contradicts CC BY 2.5. Article-level attribution is required and is
recorded in `../document_manifest.tsv` at the package root.

Do not apply MIT or CC0 to these source-bearing files.
